results.title: Walz Freezes Mining Near Boundary Waters, Setting Up Fight With GOP
results.description: Gov. Tim Walz froze mining permits across 350 square miles near Minnesota's Boundary Waters, drawing praise and GOP backlash.

results.title: Ecuadorean diplomat nominated as candidate to lead UN
results.description: Ecuadorean diplomat Ivonne Baki has joined the race to become the next secretary-general of the United Nations, the eighth candidate to replace Portugal’s Antonio Guterres next year, documents showed on Tuesday.
